input.prompt: The background is a hand-painted gouache poster-colour painting in the mid-century American television animation manner: stylized graphic shapes, flat colour areas broken by sponge-dabbed texture and dry-brush streaks, lumpy paper-cut clouds, a limited palette, crisp finished painting. Match the reference image exactly in painting style, colours and the look of the ribbon. A wide eye-catch card: the same cartoon ribbon scroll banner, now SMALL, exactly centred in the frame both horizontally and vertically, spanning only 44% of the frame width and about 22% of the frame height including its folded tomato-red ends, its long middle face completely blank cream. Around it a wide painted turquoise sky with lumpy clouds reaching every edge of the frame, and a thin strip of crooked little rooftops and round trees along the very bottom edge only. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no flags, no signs with writing.
